summary: Defines DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 options that give a list of IP addresses for PANA Authentication Agents. This is one of the ways a PANA client can find the authentication agents. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: When you arrive at a new network you need to know who checks passes. This lets the network hand you the addresses of the checkers.
